spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes future capture classification only. It does not hold or release any existing unit and does not remove marketplace offers.
A wildcard can affect many future product types. Read the current rows before setting one.

description: Set a workspace rule for future extension-captured sealed purchases. An exact game and productType wins over wildcard rules. Read spellbook_sealed_intent_defaults before and after; existing units keep their current marks.

game.description: The game to match, or * for every game. Required.

intent.description: The capture intent: open or hold. This does not physically open or list stock. Required.

productType.description: The sealed product type to match, or * for every type. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose rule to set. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_intent_default_set
